# Remove duplicate phrases and repeated words function 

```{r}
remove_duplicates <- function(s) {
  # Leave NAs as is
  if (is.na(s)) return(NA_character_)

  # Remove any extra white space
  s <- trimws(gsub("\\s+", " ", s))
  
  # Make empty strings R's NA val
  if (s == "") return(NA_character_)

  # Split the string into words
  words <- strsplit(s, " ", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  lower <- tolower(words) # convert to lowercase
  n <- length(words) # number of words

  # Check for repeated phrases
  for (k in seq_len(floor(n / 2))) {
    if (n %% k == 0) {
      phrase <- lower[1:k] # 1st phrase
      repeated <- rep(phrase, n / k) # repeat the phrase

      # Check if the string is the repeated phrase
      if (all(lower == repeated)) {
        return(paste(words[1:k], collapse = " "))
      }
    }
  }

  # If there are duplicated words, remove them (ex. PAIRED paired Paired: only keep 1)
  words <- words[c(TRUE, lower[-1] != lower[-n])]

  # Put the words back into the string
  paste(words, collapse = " ")
}
```

# First_nonempty function to get the first value across multiple columns to put in a harmonized column

```{r}
# Function to retrieve the first non-empty (no NAs) entry from the cols given
first_nonempty <- function(...) {                
  x <- c(...) # combine all inputs into one vector
  x <- trimws(as.character(x)) # remove any extra white space
  x[x %in% c("", "NA", "NaN", "NULL", "missing", "Missing", "MISSING", "unknown", "Unknown", "UNKNOWN", "not applicable", "Not applicable", "none")] <- NA_character_ # replace NaN's with R's NA val
  x <- x[!is.na(x)] # remove NAs
  if (length(x) == 0) NA_character_ else x[[1]] # return NA if empty, otherwise first value
}

```

# Function to replace common missing data terms with NA

```{r}
clean_df_missing <- function(df) {
  # Missing data terms to be replaced with R's NA
  missing_terms <- c("na", "n/a", "nan", "null", "missing", "unknown", "not applicable", "none", "")
  
  # Iterate through the df cols
  for (col in names(df)) {
    # Only check character cols
    if (is.character(df[[col]])) {
      # Remove any extra white space and make lowercase to compare to missing_terms
      x_clean <- trimws(tolower(df[[col]]))
      
      # Replace missing terms with NA
      df[[col]][x_clean %in% missing_terms] <- NA
    }
  }
  
  return(df)
}

```

# Remove NaNs, duplicate phrases and words and replace missing data with NA

```{r}
# Remove the string "nan" from the df
metadata_harmonized[] <- lapply(metadata_harmonized, function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    x <- gsub("\\bnan\\b", "", x, ignore.case = TRUE) # remove nan
    x <- trimws(gsub("\\s+", " ", x)) # remove extra white space
    x[x == ""] <- NA_character_ # make empty strings R's NA val 
  }
  x # return the column
})

```

```{r}
# Apply the remove_duplicates() function to the df to remove duplicate phrases and words
metadata_harmonized[] <- lapply(metadata_harmonized, function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    # Remove repeated phrases in each cell and return the cleaned col
    vapply(x, remove_duplicates, character(1))
  } else {
    x # return cols that aren't characters unchanged
  }
})

```

```{r}
# Apply the clean_df_missing() function to the df to put NAs for any common missing terms
metadata_harmonized <- clean_df_missing(metadata_harmonized)

```

```{r}
  metadata_harmonized$host_sex,

)))
```


```{r}
# Create a temp combined col for all sex col values using first_nonempty()
metadata_harmonized$sex_combined <- apply(metadata_harmonized[, sex_cols], 1, first_nonempty)

# Create paipu_sex col for harmonized values
metadata_harmonized$paipu_sex <- "UNKNOWN"

# Harmonize biological sex
# Both / mixed
metadata_harmonized$paipu_sex[
  metadata_harmonized$sex_combined %in% c("B") |
    grepl("\\bmixed\\b", metadata_harmonized$sex_combined, ignore.case = TRUE) |
    grepl("pooled male and female", metadata_harmonized$sex_combined, ignore.case = TRUE) |
    grepl("male and female", metadata_harmonized$sex_combined, ignore.case = TRUE)
] <- "BOTH"

# Female
metadata_harmonized$paipu_sex[
  grepl("\\bfemale\\b", metadata_harmonized$sex_combined, ignore.case = TRUE)] <- "FEMALE"

# Male
metadata_harmonized$paipu_sex[
  grepl("\\bmale\\b", metadata_harmonized$sex_combined, ignore.case = TRUE) |
  metadata_harmonized$sex_combined %in% c("M")
] <- "MALE"


# Drop the temp col sex_combined
metadata_harmonized <- metadata_harmonized %>% select(-sex_combined)
```

```{r}
# Helpers for regex
sep <- "[-_\\s]*" # any dash, underscore or spaces between words
edge <- "(^|[^A-Za-z0-9])" # start of string (only words separated from others and not embedded inside)
tail <- "($|[^A-Za-z0-9])" # end of string (only words separated from others and not embedded inside)

# Function to create a regex that matches a whole word
word_match <- function(word) {
  paste0(edge, word, tail)
}

# Function to create a regex that matches a phrase with separators between words
phrase_match <- function(words) {
  paste0(edge, paste(words, collapse = sep), tail)
}

# Function to combine many regex patterns with 'or'
any_match <- function(...) {
  parts <- unlist(list(...))
  paste0("(", paste(parts, collapse = "|"), ")")
}
```

```{r}
# Create tissue patterns
tissue_patterns <- c(
  lymph_node = any_match(phrase_match(c("lymph", "node")),
          phrase_match(c("lymph", "nodes")), word_match("tdln"), 
          word_match("dln"), word_match("ln"),
          word_match("cln")),
  
  endothelium = any_match(word_match("endothelium"), word_match("endothelial")),
  
  spleen = any_match(word_match("spleen"), word_match("splenic"),
          word_match("splenocytes"),
          word_match("splenocyte"),
          word_match("spleen1"),
          word_match("spleen2"),
          word_match("spleen3")),
  
  blood = any_match(word_match("blood"), phrase_match(c("peripheral", "blood"))),
  
  serum = word_match("serum"),
  
  spinal_cord = phrase_match(c("spinal", "cord")),
  
  brain = any_match(word_match("brain"), word_match("neocortex"), 
          phrase_match(c("prefrontal", "cortex")),
          phrase_match(c("brain", "cortex")), 
          phrase_match(c("cerebral", "cortex")),
          word_match("cerebellum"), 
          word_match("cerebellar"),
          word_match("cerebella"), word_match("hippocampus"),
          word_match("thalamus"), 
          word_match("brainstem"), word_match("glioma"),
          word_match("glioblastoma"),
          word_match("medulloblastoma"), word_match("gbm"),
          word_match("glioblatoma"),
          word_match("hindbrain"),
          phrase_match(c("intracranial", "tumor")),
          word_match("amygdala"),
          phrase_match(c("brian", "tumor")),
          phrase_match(c("central", "nervous", "system")),
          phrase_match(c("choroid", "plexus")),
          phrase_match(c("tumor", "neurospheres")),
          word_match("hypothalamus"),
          phrase_match(c("cerebellum", "tumor")),
          phrase_match(c("cerebelllum", "tumor"))),
  
  lung = any_match(word_match("lung"), word_match("lungs"),
        word_match("nsclc"), word_match("sclc"),
        word_match("bronchiolar"),
        word_match("basc")),
  
  liver = any_match(word_match("liver"), word_match("hepatic"),
          word_match("hepatocellular"), 
          word_match("cholangiocarcinoma"),
          phrase_match(c("den", "induced", "tumors")),
          word_match("hcc"), word_match("hepatoblastoma")),
  
  pancreas = any_match(word_match("pancreas"),
            word_match("pancrease"),
            word_match("pancreatic"),
            word_match("pdac"), 
            phrase_match(c("islet", "of", "langerhans")),
            phrase_match(c("pda", "tumor")),
            word_match("pancreata"),
            word_match("kpc")),
  
  kidney = any_match(word_match("kidney"), word_match("renal"),
          phrase_match(c("renal", "cortex")), word_match("ccrcc")),
  
  bladder = any_match(word_match("bladder"), word_match("urothelial"), 
          phrase_match(c("urinary", "bladder"))),
  
  heart = any_match(word_match("heart"),
          word_match("cardiomyocytes")),
  
  aorta = word_match("aorta"),
  
  esophagus = any_match(word_match("esophagus"), word_match("esophageal")),
  
  oral = any_match(word_match("oral"),
          phrase_match(c("oral", "mucosa")), 
          phrase_match(c("oral", "cavity")), 
          phrase_match(c("oral", "tongue")), 
          phrase_match(c("oral", "buccal")), 
          word_match("gingiva"), 
          word_match("buccal"),
          word_match("tongue"),
          phrase_match(c("head", "and", "neck", "squamous", "cell", "carcinoma")),
          phrase_match(c("oraol", "squamous", "cell", "carcinoma")),
          phrase_match(c("oral", "squamous", "cell", "carcinoma")),
          phrase_match(c("opscc", "tumor"))),
  
  stomach = any_match(word_match("stomach"), word_match("gastric"),
                      word_match("forestomach"),
                      word_match("gan-kp")),
  
  small_intestine = any_match(phrase_match(c("small", "intestine")), 
          phrase_match(c("small", "intestinal")), word_match("ileum"),

          word_match("duodenum")),
  
  large_intestine = any_match(word_match("colon"), word_match("colonic"),

          phrase_match(c("basal", "cell", "carcinoma")),
          word_match("hypodermis"), phrase_match(c("hair", "follicle")),
          phrase_match(c("bulge", "hair", "follicle", "stem", "cells")),
          phrase_match(c("cutaneous", "squamous", "cell", "carcinoma")),
          phrase_match(c("merkel", "cell", "carcinoma"))),
  
  muscle = any_match(word_match("muscle"),
          phrase_match(c("skeletal", "muscle")), 
          word_match("gastrocnemius"), word_match("soleus"), 
          phrase_match(c("tibialis","anterior")),
          word_match("tibialis"),
          word_match("quadricep"), word_match("quadriceps"),
         word_match("rhabdomyosarcoma"),
         phrase_match(c("tibilias", "anterior", "muscles"))),
  
  bone_marrow = any_match(phrase_match(c("bone", "marrow")), word_match("bm"),
                phrase_match(c("myeloid", "sarcoma", "tumor"))),
  
  bone = any_match(word_match("bone"), word_match("osteosarcoma"),
          word_match("tibia")),
  
  mammary = any_match(word_match("mammary"), word_match("breast"),
          word_match("mamary"), word_match("mfp")),
  
  ovary = any_match(word_match("ovary"), word_match("ovarian")),
  
  uterus = any_match(word_match("uterus"), word_match("uterine")),
  
  testis = any_match(word_match("testis"), word_match("testes"), 
          word_match("scrotum"), phrase_match(c("seminal", "vesicle"))),
  
  prostate = any_match(word_match("prostate"), word_match("prostatic")),
  
  penis = any_match(word_match("penis"), word_match("penile")),
  
  bile_duct = phrase_match(c("bile", "duct")),
  
  adrenal_gland = any_match(phrase_match(c("adrenal", "gland")),
                  word_match("adrenal"),
                  word_match("th-mycn"),
                  word_match("thmycn"),
                  word_match("pheochromocytoma"),
                  phrase_match(c("paraspinal", "thoracic", "tumor"))),
  
  thyroid = word_match("thyroid"),
  
  pituitary_gland = word_match("pituitary"),
  
  salivary_gland = any_match(phrase_match(c("salivary", "gland")), 
            phrase_match(c("submandibular", "gland")), word_match("smg")),
  
  omentum = any_match(word_match("omentum"), word_match("omental")),
  
  peritoneum = any_match(word_match("peritoneum"), 
          phrase_match(c("peritoneal", "cavity")),
          phrase_match(c("peritoneal", "primary", "tumor"))),
  
  thymus = any_match(word_match("thymus"), word_match("thymic")),
  
  diaphragm = word_match("diaphragm"),
  
  soft_tissue = any_match(word_match("fibrosarcoma"), 
          phrase_match(c("soft", "tissue", "sarcoma")),
          phrase_match(c("undifferentiated", "pleomorphic", "sarcoma")),
          phrase_match(c("gastrointestinal", "stromal", "tumor")),
          word_match("aspscr1-tfe3"),
          phrase_match(c("epithelioid", "hemangioendothelioma"))),
  
  adipose_tissue = any_match(phrase_match(c("adipose", "tissue")),
          phrase_match(c("normal", "adipose"))),
  
  nerve = any_match(
    phrase_match(c("peripheral", "nerve")),
    phrase_match(c("nerve", "sheath")),
    phrase_match(c("sciatic", "nerve")),
    word_match("mpnst"), word_match("pnst"),
    phrase_match(c("coelic", "ganglia")),
    phrase_match(c("dorsal", "root", "ganglia")),
    phrase_match(c("dorsal", "root", "ganglion")),
    word_match("drg")),
  
  embryo = any_match(word_match("blastocyst"), 
          word_match("embryo"), word_match("embryonic"),
          phrase_match(c("embryonic", "stem"))),
  
  fallopian_tube = any_match(word_match("oviduct"),
          phrase_match(c("fallopian", "tube")),
          phrase_match(c("fallopian", "tubes")),
          phrase_match(c("fallopian", "tube", "tissue")),
          phrase_match(c("fallopian", "tube", "epithelium"))),
  
  eye = any_match(word_match("eye"), word_match("ocular"), 
          word_match("retina"), phrase_match(c("optic", "nerve")),
          word_match("photoreceptor"),
          phrase_match(c("retinal", "tissue"))),
  
  ascites = any_match(word_match("ascites"), word_match("ascite"),
          phrase_match(c("tumor", "ascites"))),
  
  peritoneum = any_match(word_match("peritoneum"),
    phrase_match(c("peritoneal", "cavity")),
    phrase_match(c("peritoneal", "lavage"))),
  
  pleura = any_match(word_match("pleura"), word_match("pleural"))
)
```

```{r}
extract_explicit_tissue <- function(x) {
  if (is.na(x)) return(NA_character_)
  
  # Make tissue lowercase and trim any extra white space
  s <- str_to_lower(trimws(x))
  
  # If empty, set to NA
  if (s %in% c("")) return(NA_character_)
  
  # Handle cortex
  if (s %in% c("cortex")) return("brain")
  if (str_detect(s, phrase_match(c("renal", "cortex")))) return("kidney")
  
  # Check if a tissue has cell line in it
  is_cell_line <- str_detect(s, phrase_match(c("cell", "line")))
  
  for (tissue in names(tissue_patterns)) {
    if (str_detect(s, tissue_patterns[tissue])) {
      tissue_name <- gsub("_", " ", tissue) # remove underscore from var name for tissue label
      # If it's a cell line, add cell line to the tissue label
      if (is_cell_line) {
        tissue_name <- paste(tissue_name, " cell line")
      }
      
      return(tissue_name)
    }
  }
  
  # Known model cell line
  if (str_detect(s, "(^|[^a-z0-9])mc38[a-z0-9-]*($|[^a-z0-9])")) {
    return("colon cell line")
  }
  
  if (str_detect(s, any_match(
      word_match("ct26"),
      word_match("ct26lacz"),
      word_match("ct26wt"),
      phrase_match(c("ct26", "tumor")),
      phrase_match(c("ct26", "induced", "tumour")),
      phrase_match(c("ct26", "subcutaneous", "tumors")),
      phrase_match(c("colon26", "tumor")),
      phrase_match(c("ct26", "solid", "tumors")),
      phrase_match(c("hct", "116", "xenograft", "tumors")),
      phrase_match(c("hct", "116", "xenograft", "tumor")),
      phrase_match(c("mc", "38", "cell", "line", "derived", "orthotopic", "tumor"))))) {
      return("colon cell line")
    }

  if (str_detect(s, any_match(word_match("b16"), word_match("b16f10")))) {
    return("skin cell line")
  }

  if (str_detect(s, any_match(word_match("gl261"), word_match("smowt-mb"))))
    return("brain cell line")
  
  if (str_detect(s, any_match(word_match("4t1"), word_match("67nr"),
    word_match("6dt1"), word_match("e0771"), word_match("66cl4"),
    word_match("py230"), word_match("mda-f471"), word_match("2225l"),
    word_match("4t1opn-ko"), word_match("4t1wt"), word_match("hc11"),
    phrase_match(c("human", "tnbc", "tumor")),
    phrase_match(c("66cl4", "primary", "tumor")),
    phrase_match(c("eo771", "tumor"))))) {
    return("mammary cell line")
  }
  
  if (str_detect(s, word_match("c2c12"))) {
    return("muscle cell line")
  }
  
  if (str_detect(s, any_match(word_match("panc02"), word_match("panco2"),
    word_match("un-kc-6141"), word_match("n134"),
    phrase_match(c("n134", "subcutaneous", "tumor"))))) {
    return("pancreas cell line")
    }
  
  if (str_detect(s, any_match(word_match("myc-cap"), word_match("myccap"), word_match("b6myc-cap"), word_match("b6myccap")))) {
    return("prostate cell line")
  }
  
  if (str_detect(s, any_match(word_match("mca205"),
    word_match("mca-205"), word_match("c3h10t1/2"),
    phrase_match(c("sarcoma", "cell", "line"))))) {
    return("soft tissue cell line")
  }
  
  if (str_detect(s, any_match(word_match("el4"), word_match("EL4")))) {
    return("thymus cell line")
  }
  
  if (str_detect(s, any_match(
    word_match("at84"),
    word_match("at-84"),
    word_match("moc1"),
    word_match("moc2")
  ))) {
    return("oral cell line")
  }
  
  if (str_detect(s, any_match(word_match("llc"),
  word_match("llc1"), phrase_match(c("3ll", "r", "subcutaneous", "tumor", "tissue"))))) {
    return("lung cell line")
  }
  
  if (str_detect(s, phrase_match(c("kpc", "luad", "tumor")))) {
    return("lung")
  }
  
  if (str_detect(s, any_match(word_match("hep3b"),
      word_match("hepa1-6"), word_match("hepa1.6"), word_match("hepa1-6"),
      word_match("hep1-6"),
      phrase_match(c("hepatocyte", "cell", "line")),
      phrase_match(c("hepa1", "6", "orthotopic", "tumor")),
      phrase_match(c("mouse", "hepa1", "6", "tumor")),
      phrase_match(c("hepa1", "6", "hepatoma", "carcinoma", "cell"))))){
        return("liver cell line")
  }
  
  if (str_detect(s, any_match(word_match("311e"), 
  word_match("317e")))) {
    return("esophagus cell line")
  }
  
  if (str_detect(s, phrase_match(c("5tgm1", "tumor")))) {
    return("bone marrow cell line") 
  }

  
  ## Other specific mappings --------------------------
  if (str_detect(s, any_match(
    phrase_match(c("t", "cell", "acute", "lymphoblastic", "leukemia")),
    phrase_match(c("lymphoblastic", "leukemia"))
  ))) {
    return("bone marrow")
  }
  
  if (str_detect(s, word_match("pdx1"))) {
    return("pancreas")
  }
  
  if (str_detect(s, any_match(word_match("pymt"), phrase_match(c("mmtv", "pymt"))))) {
    return("mammary")
  }
  
  if (str_detect(s, any_match(word_match("pymt"), phrase_match(c("mmtv", "pymt")), phrase_match(c("2153l", "gemm", "tnbc", "tumor"))))) {
    return("mammary")
  }
  
  # Checked and all shoulder samples have 'melanoma' as their cancer type
  if (str_detect(s, word_match("shoulder"))) {
    return("skin")
  }
  
  # Samples are melanoma
  if (str_detect(s, any_match(word_match("mt-ret"), word_match("mtret"), 
      phrase_match(c("tumor", "vgp")), word_match("mo5")))) {
    return("skin")
  }
  
  if (str_detect(s, phrase_match(c("mouse", "sarcoma", "mn", "mca1", "tumor")))) {
    return("soft tissue")
  }

  if (s %in% c(
  "mouse sarcoma mn/mca1 tumor",
  "primary p53/mca sarcoma")) {
    return("soft tissue")
  }
  
  if (s %in% c("nf1fl/fl; dhhcre neurofibroma","neurofibroma tumor")) {
    return("nerve")
  }
  
  if (str_detect(s, phrase_match(c("angiosarcoma", "tumor")))) {
    return("soft tissue cell line")
  }
  
  NA_character_ # otherwise NA
}

# Apply function to extract explicit tissue label from paipu_tissue
metadata_harmonized$paipu_tissue_explicit <- vapply(
  metadata_harmonized$paipu_tissue,
  extract_explicit_tissue,
  FUN.VALUE = character(1)
)
```

# Check if any other columns can be harmonized

```{r}
# Get all col names
cols <- names(metadata_harmonized)

# Function to split a col name into individual words
get_words <- function(x) {
  
  words <- x %>%
    str_to_lower() %>% # make lowercase
    str_replace_all("[^a-z0-9]+", " ") %>% # replace underscores, etc with spaces
    str_squish() %>% # remove extra spaces
    str_split(" ") %>% # split into words using spaces
    unlist()
  
  # Remove common words
  setdiff(unique(words), c("of", "the", "and"))
}


# Function to calculate how similar two column names are
jaccard_similarity <- function(x, y) {
  x_words <- get_words(x)
  y_words <- get_words(y)
  
  # Number of shared words / total unique words
  length(intersect(x_words, y_words)) /
    length(union(x_words, y_words))
}

# Make column pairs
column_pairs <- expand.grid(
  col1 = cols,
  col2 = cols,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  # Don't compare cols with themselves and remove duplicate pairs
  filter(col1 < col2) %>%
  
  # Calculate similarity for each pair
  mutate(
    similarity = map2_dbl(col1, col2, jaccard_similarity)
  ) %>%
  
  # Sort by similarity score
  arrange(desc(similarity))

# Look at col pairs with >= 50% similarity
similar_columns <- column_pairs %>%
  filter(similarity >= 0.5)

View(similar_columns)
```

```{r}
# List of cols to remove from similar col names
cols_to_drop <- c("sex", "gender", "arrayexpress_sex", "cell_sex", "host_mouse_gender", "mouse_sex", "strain_sex", "host_sex", "tumor_grade", "tumor_grading", "tumor_grading_obi_0600002_", "dose", "dosage", "radiation_dose", "concentration", "h2o2_concentration",
"scientific_name", "instrument_model", infection_cols, celltype_cols, tumor_site_cols, treatment_cols, timepoint_cols, sampling_time_cols, strain_cols, development_stage_cols)

exclude_cols <- c(cols_to_drop, tissue_cols)

# Remove cols that were already harmonized and cols that start with 'paipu' from similar col names
similar_columns_update <- similar_columns %>%
  filter(
    !col1 %in% exclude_cols,
    !col2 %in% exclude_cols,
    !str_starts(col1, "paipu"), # exclude cols that were harmonized already
    !str_starts(col2, "paipu")
  )

View(similar_columns_update)
```

```{r}
# Put all into harmonize_groups

  tumor_index = tumor_index_cols,

  rnaseq_run = rnaseq_run_cols,
  pathological_status = pathological_status_cols,
  p53_status = p53_status_cols,
  sorted_cell_population = sorted_cell_population_cols,
  treatment_days = treatment_days_cols,
  time_after_treatment = time_after_treatment_cols,
  injected_cell_line = injected_cell_line_cols,
  days_post_inoculation = days_post_inoculation_cols,

  cell_line_genotype = cell_line_genotype_cols,

  mouse_number = mouse_number_cols,

  cell_subtype = cell_subtype_cols,

)
```

# Harmonize all given columns

```{r}
# Create harmonized columns using first non-empty value
for (hg in names(harmonize_groups)) {
  metadata_harmonized[[paste0("paipu_", hg)]] <- apply(
    metadata_harmonized[, harmonize_groups[[hg]], drop = FALSE],
    1,
    first_nonempty
  )
}
```


# Harmonize cancer type
# PRJNA612618, PRJNA573945 - paipu_cancer_type = head and neck squamous cell carcinoma
# PRJNA713335 - paipu_cancer_type = triple-negative breast cancer, paipu_cancer_type_final = breast cancer (or mammary cancer)
# PRJNA704914 - paipu_cancer_type = soft tissue sarcoma, paipu_cancer_type_final = sarcoma
# PRJNA744938 - paipu_cancer_type = Lewis lung carcinoma, paipu_cancer_type_final = lung cancer
# PRJNA848761 - paipu_cancer_type = cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma
# PRJNA826889 - paipu_cancer_type = spindle cell carcinoma

```{r}
  mutate(
    paipu_cancer_type = if_else(
      # If cancer type is NA, but the sample has a tissue value:
      is.na(paipu_cancer_type) & !is.na(paipu_tissue_explicit),
      
      # Make the cancer type: <tissue name> + tumor; remove 'cell line' from tissue labels that have it
      paste0(str_remove(paipu_tissue_explicit, " cell line$"), " tumor"),
      
      # Otherwise, keep the current cancer type value
      paipu_cancer_type
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# Fill in NA cancer types using info from other metadata cols
metadata_harmonized <- metadata_harmonized %>%
  mutate(
    paipu_cancer_type = case_when(
      
      # Keep cancer types that have already been assigned
      !is.na(paipu_cancer_type) ~ paipu_cancer_type,

      # using source_name
      # Bladder cancer
      source_name %in% c("primary mouse bladder urothelial cells") & str_detect(cell_type, phrase_match(c("bladder", "tumor", "cells"))) ~ "bladder cancer",
      
      source_name %in% c("bladder tumor") ~ "bladder cancer",
      
      # Brain cancer
      source_name %in% c("mouse brainstem tumor") ~ "brain cancer",
                  
      # Breast cancer
      str_detect(source_name, any_match(
        word_match("e0771"),
        word_match("pymt"),
        word_match("mmtv-wnt1"),
        word_match("mmtv-bo1"),
        word_match("4t1"),
        word_match("emt-6"),
        word_match("emt6"),
        word_match("d2a1"),
        phrase_match(c("at-3", "cell", "line")),
        phrase_match(c("mammary", "tumor")),
        phrase_match(c("breast", "tumor")),
        phrase_match(c("mammary", "gland", "tumor")),
        phrase_match(c("tumor", "breast")))
        ) ~ "mammary cancer",
      
      source_name %in% c("cancer associated fibroblasts") & str_detect(strain, word_match("mmtv-pymt")) ~
  "mammary tumor",
  
      str_detect(source_name, word_match("4t07")) ~ "triple-negative breast cancer",
  
      # Colorectal cancer
      str_detect(source_name, any_match(
        word_match("ct26"),
        word_match("mc38"),
        phrase_match(c("colon", "cancer")))
      ) ~ "colorectal cancer",
      
      source_name %in% c("akps tumoroids", "aksp tumoroids") & str_detect(cell_type, phrase_match(c("Epithelial", "inestinal", "tumoroids"))) ~ "colorectal cancer",
  
      source_name %in% c("tumor-bearing omentum") & str_detect(cell_line, word_match("MC38")) ~ "colorectal cancer",

      # Ependymoma (brain cancer)
      str_detect(source_name, phrase_match(c("zfta-rela", "ependymoma"))
) ~ "ZFTA-RELA ependymoma",
      
      # Glioma
      str_detect(source_name, any_match(
         word_match("gl261"),
         word_match("gl261"))
      ) ~ "glioma",
      
      source_name %in% c("glioma cells", "glioma-surrounding cells") ~ "glioma",

      # Hepatocellular carcinoma / liver
      str_detect(source_name, word_match("hcc")) ~ "hepatocellular carcinoma",
      str_detect(source_name, word_match("hepa1-6")) ~ "hepatocellular carcinoma",
      str_detect(source_name, phrase_match(c("liver", "tumors"))) ~ "liver cancer",
            
      # Kidney cancer
      str_detect(source_name, any_match(
        phrase_match(c("kidney", "tumor")),
        phrase_match(c("kidney", "tumors")))
      ) ~ "kidney cancer",
  
      # Lung cancer
      str_detect(source_name, any_match(
        phrase_match(c("mouse", "lung", "tumor")),
        phrase_match(c("lung", "tumor")))
      ) ~ "lung cancer",
  
      source_name %in% c("lewis lung carcinoma tumors - in vivo") ~ "lewis lung carcinoma",
  
      # Lymphoma and leukemia
      str_detect(source_name, phrase_match(c("mouse", "lymphoma", "cells"))) ~ "lymphoma",
      str_detect(source_name, word_match("b-all")) ~ "b-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia",
      str_detect(source_name, phrase_match(c("thymic", "lymphoma"))) ~ "thymic lymphoma",
  
      # Melanoma
      bioproject == "PRJNA548090" & source_name %in% c(
          "braf/pten ntt tumor cells",
          "braf/pten rtt tumor cells",
          "braf/pten tumor cells in vitro",
          "braf tumor cells in vitro"
      ) ~ "melanoma",

  
      str_detect(source_name, any_match(
        word_match("b16f10"),
        word_match("b16.f10"),
        word_match("b16f1cova"),
        word_match("yumm1.7"),
        word_match("b2905"),
        phrase_match(c("b16", "tumor")))
      )  ~ "melanoma",
  
  
      source_name %in% c("intracranial tumor") & cell_type %in% c("B16 F1") ~ "melanoma",
      
      # Ovarian cancer
      str_detect(source_name, any_match(word_match("id8"),
        phrase_match(c("kpca", "tumor")))
      ) ~ "ovarian cancer",
      
      # Pancreatic cancer
      str_detect(source_name, any_match(
        phrase_match(c("kp", "pancreas", "cancer", "cells")),
        phrase_match(c("6694c2", "pancreatic", "tumor", "cell", "clone")))
      ) ~ "pancreatic cancer",
      
      source_name %in% c("pancreatic cells") ~ "pancreatic cancer",
  
      source_name %in% c("kp2") & str_detect(cell_type, phrase_match(c("PDAC", "Tumor", "cells"))) ~ "pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma",
      
      str_detect(source_name, any_match(word_match("pdac"), word_match("pda"), word_match("pancova"))) ~
        "pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma",

      # Prostate tumor
      source_name %in% c("prostate tumor tissue", "prostate tissue") ~ "prostate tumor",
      source_name %in% c("tramp-c2 tumor") ~ "prostate cancer",
      
      # Skin tumor
      str_detect(source_name, any_match(phrase_match(c("skin", "tumor")),
        phrase_match(c("whole", "skin")))
        ) ~ "skin tumor",

      # Stomach cancer
      str_detect(source_name, phrase_match(c("gastric", "tumor", "organoids"))) ~ "stomach cancer",
  
      # Synovial sarcoma
      source_name %in% c("primary tumor from hind limb") ~ "synovial sarcoma",
      
      # Thyroid cancer
      source_name %in% c("thyroid tumor cell line") ~ "thyroid cancer",


      # using cell_type
      str_detect(cell_type, phrase_match(c("bladder", "tumor", "cells"))) ~ "bladder tumor",
  
      # using disease
      disease %in% c("Lymphoma") ~ "lymphoma",
      disease %in% c("Lymphoma_spread_to_liver") ~ "lymphoma",
      disease %in% c("Lewis lung carcinoma") ~ "lewis lung carcinoma",
      disease %in% c("glioblastoma") ~ "glioblastoma",

      # using primary_tumor_type
      primary_tumor_type %in% c("mouse mammary cancer") ~ "mammary tumor",

      # using tumor_diagnosis
      tumor_diagnosis %in% c("Mammary Sarcoma") ~ "mammary sarcoma",
      tumor_diagnosis %in% c("Metaplastic Adenosquamous Carcinoma") ~
        "metaplastic adenosquamous carcinoma",

      # using tumor_type
      # Breast cancer
      tumor_type %in% c("Py8119 mammary tumors") ~ "mammary tumor",
      tumor_type %in% c("Spontaneous mammary primary tumor") ~ "mammary tumor",

      # Carcinomas
      tumor_type %in% c("High Grade Serous Carcinoma (HGSC)") ~
        "high grade serous carcinoma",
      tumor_type %in% c("Endometrioid Carcinoma (EC)") ~
        "endometrioid carcinoma",
      tumor_type %in% c("Malignant Mixed Mullerian Tumor (MMMT)") ~
        "malignant mixed mullerian tumor",

      # Lymphomas
      tumor_type %in% c("thymic lymphoma") ~ "thymic lymphoma",
      str_detect(tumor_type, word_match("PTCL")) ~ "peripheral t-cell lymphoma",

      # Colorectal cancer
      str_detect(tumor_type, word_match("MC38")) ~ "colorectal cancer",

      # Melanoma
      str_detect(tumor_type, word_match("B16-Ova")) ~ "melanoma",

      # Pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor
      str_detect(tumor_type, word_match("PanNET")) ~ "pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor",
      str_detect(tumor_type, word_match("RIP1TAG2")) ~ "pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor",

      # Sarcoma
      tumor_type %in% c("UPS") ~ "undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma",

      # using title
      # Colorectal cancer
      str_detect(title, any_match(word_match("MC38"), word_match("CT26"))) ~ "colorectal cancer",
  
      # Melanoma
      str_detect(title, word_match("B16")) ~ "melanoma",
      
      # Otherwise leave as NA
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
```

```{r}
eye <- c("eye cancer")

genitourinary <- c("bladder cancer", "kidney cancer", "prostate cancer", "testicular cancer")

musculoskeletal <- c("adipose tissue tumor", "bone cancer", "muscle tumor", "sarcoma", "soft tissue tumor")

neurologic <- c("brain cancer", "nerve cancer", "neuroblastoma", "zfta-rela ependymoma")

gynecologic <- c("cervical cancer", "endometrial cancer", "fallopian tube cancer", "malignant mixed mullerian tumor", "ovarian cancer", "peritoneal cancer", "uterine cancer")

respiratory <- c("lung cancer", "mesothelioma", "thymic cancer")

head_neck <- c("head and neck cancer", "oral tumor", "salivary gland cancer", "thyroid cancer") 

skin <- c("basal cell carcinoma", "melanoma", "merkel cell carcinoma")

unspecified <- c("adenocarcinoma", "ascites tumor", "embryo tumor", "endothelium tumor", "heart cancer", "metastatic cancer", "omentum tumor", "onco*", "recurrent cancer", "rhabdoid tumor", "serum tumor", "spindle cell carcinoma", "spleen tumor", "squamous cell carcinoma", "tumor*", "vascular tumor")


# Create a cancer_system column
metadata_harmonized <- metadata_harmonized %>%
  mutate(paipu_cancer_system = case_when(
    paipu_cancer_type_final %in% blood ~ "Hematologic_Blood",
    paipu_cancer_type_final %in% breast ~ "Breast",
    paipu_cancer_type_final %in% digestive ~ "Digestive_Gastrointestinal",
    paipu_cancer_type_final %in% endocrine ~ "Endocrine_Neuroendocrine",
    paipu_cancer_type_final %in% eye ~ "Eye",
    paipu_cancer_type_final %in% genitourinary ~ "Genitourinary",
    paipu_cancer_type_final %in% gynecologic ~ "Gynecologic",
    paipu_cancer_type_final %in% head_neck ~ "Head and Neck",
    paipu_cancer_type_final %in% musculoskeletal ~ "Musculoskeletal",
    paipu_cancer_type_final %in% neurologic ~ "Neurologic",
    paipu_cancer_type_final %in% respiratory ~ "Respiratory_Thoracic",
    paipu_cancer_type_final %in% skin ~ "Skin",
    paipu_cancer_type_final %in% unspecified ~ "Unspecified"
  ))
                                
# Check the new col
table(metadata_harmonized$paipu_cancer_system)
```

```{r}
# Update cancer system
metadata_harmonized <- metadata_harmonized %>%
  mutate(
    paipu_cancer_system = case_when(
      # Squamous cell carcinoma
      paipu_cancer_type_final == "squamous cell carcinoma" & paipu_tissue_final %in% c("oral", "oral cell line") ~ "Head and Neck",
      paipu_cancer_type_final == "squamous cell carcinoma" & paipu_tissue_final %in% c("skin", "skin cell line") ~ "Skin",
      paipu_cancer_type_final == "squamous cell carcinoma" & paipu_tissue_final %in% c("lung") ~ "Respiratory_Thoracic",
      paipu_cancer_type_final == "squamous cell carcinoma" & paipu_tissue_final %in% c("esophagus") ~ "Digestive_Gastrointestinal",
      paipu_cancer_type_final == "squamous cell carcinoma" & paipu_tissue_final %in% c("penis") ~ "Genitourinary",

      paipu_cancer_type_final == "nutm1-rearranged carcinoma" & paipu_tissue_final %in% c("oral") ~ "Head and Neck",

      paipu_cancer_type_final == "spindle cell carcinoma" & paipu_tissue_final %in% c("mammary") ~ "Breast",

      paipu_cancer_type_final == "rhabdoid tumor" & bioproject %in% c("PRJNA566112") ~ "Neurologic",

      # Otherwise, keep it as is
      TRUE ~ paipu_cancer_system
    )
  )


# Check the updated col
table(metadata_harmonized$paipu_cancer_system)
```

# Add metadata quality results

```{r}
# Read in csv with classification labels
sample_classes <- read_csv(here("data/classified_samples_updated_mouse.csv"))

# Check
head(sample_classes)
```

```{r}
# Check if all samples in mouse metadata are in the classified samples
all(metadata_harmonized$run_accession %in% sample_classes$run_accession)
```

```{r}
# Rename cols in sample_classes to the names needed for metadata_harmonized
sample_classes <- sample_classes %>%
  rename(
    paipu_is_benign = is_benign,
    paipu_is_cell_line = is_cell_line
  )

# Check
head(sample_classes)
```

```{r}
# Map the confidence_category values to the labels needed
sample_classes <- sample_classes %>%
  mutate(
    paipu_cancer_label = case_when(
      final_label == "CANCER" ~ "cancer",
      final_label == "NON_CANCER" ~ "non-cancer",
      
      # Otherwise
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    paipu_cancer_confidence = case_when(
      confidence_category == "confirmed_by_medspacy" ~ "confident",
      confidence_category == "confident_cancer" ~ "confident",
      confidence_category == "confirmed_non_cancer" ~ "confident",
      confidence_category == "likely_cancer" ~ "likely",
      confidence_category == "likely_non_cancer" ~ "likely",
      
      # Otherwise NA
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# Check
head(sample_classes)
```

```{r}
# Add sample_classes results to metadata_harmonized using run_accession to map values
metadata_harmonized <- metadata_harmonized %>%
  left_join(
    sample_classes %>% 
      select(run_accession, paipu_cancer_label, paipu_cancer_confidence, paipu_is_cell_line, paipu_is_benign),
    by = "run_accession"
  ) 
```
